## Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(snakecase)
```

## Importing new data
```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5C/5C_1586886626/HR.csv.gz") |>
  read_csv(
    show_col_types = FALSE, # printer ikke dens 'gæt' på kolonnetype
    name_repair = to_snake_case, # gør kolonne-navne til snake_case (nemmere at læse end PascalCase)
    n_max = 100 # bestemmer hvor mange rækker man læser ind fra filen (her 100), fx hvis man gerne vil lave noget prototype-kode hurtigt, så den ikke skal læse et kæmpe dataset ind
  )
```

## Making a function to add two numbers (with documentation (roxygen skeleton))
```{r}
#' Add two numbers together
#'
#' @param num1 A number here
#' @param num2 A number here
#'
#' @returns Returns the sum of two numbers
#'
add_numbers <- function(num1, num2) {
  added <- num1 + num2
  return(added)
}
```

## Making function to read in csv-files
```{r}
#' Read in one nurses' stress data file
#'
#' @param A path to a data file
#'
#' @returns outputs a dataframe / tibble
read <- function(file_path) {
  data <- file_path |>
    read_csv(
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      name_repair = to_snake_case,
      n_max = 100
    )
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5C/5C_1586886626/HR.csv.gz") |>
  read()
```

```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5C/5C_1586886712/HR.csv.gz") |>
  read()
```
